mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_center_notice(center_notice_key, title, sub_title, content, link_url, image, icon, view_count, user_code, center_code, notice_type, is_delete, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{image}, #{icon}, #{viewCount}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, 'center', 'N', SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_center_notice SET is_delete = 'Y', deleted_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_center_notice (center_notice_key, title, sub_title, content, icon, view_count, user_code, center_code, notice_type, is_delete, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{content}, #{icon}, #{viewCount}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, 'remedial', 'N', SYSDATETIME())
INSERT INTO erp_student_notice_map (notice_key, student_id, send_yn, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{studentId}, 'Y', SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_center_notice SET title = #{title}, sub_title = #{subTitle}, icon = #{icon}, content = #{content}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, image = #{image} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.app_token AS appToken, hc.class_name AS hanClassName, hc.class_type AS hanClassType, bc.class_name AS bookClassName, bc.class_type AS bookClasstype, gc.grade_name AS grade FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON s.grade_key = gc.grade_key WHERE (ta.assign_han_teacher is not null OR ta.assign_book_teacher is not null) AND s.status_key = 'ACTIVE' AND s.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY s.student_name ASC

SELECT n.id AS id, n.center_notice_key AS centerNoticeKey, n.title AS title, n.sub_title AS subTitle, n.content AS rawContent, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.icon AS icon, n.link_url AS linkUrl, n.view_count AS viewCount, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_center_notice n JOIN erp_user u ON n.user_code = u.user_code WHERE n.center_code = #{centerCode} AND n.id = #{id} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC;

SELECT classKey, className, classType FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT cc.class_key AS classKey, cc.class_name AS className, cc.class_type AS classType FROM erp_class_code cc JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (cc.class_key NOT LIKE 'NE%' OR #{centerCode} = 'PUS002') ) sub ORDER BY CASE classKey WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'P' THEN 3 WHEN 'ES' THEN 4 WHEN 'EP' THEN 5 WHEN 'EG' THEN 6 WHEN 'ED' THEN 7 WHEN 'NES' THEN 8 WHEN 'NEP' THEN 9 WHEN 'NEG' THEN 10 WHEN 'NED' THEN 11 WHEN 'HSN' THEN 12 WHEN 'HSU' THEN 13 WHEN 'HSX' THEN 14 WHEN 'HSS' THEN 15 WHEN 'HSA' THEN 16 WHEN 'K' THEN 17 WHEN 'M' THEN 18 WHEN 'J' THEN 19 WHEN 'SU' THEN 20 WHEN 'DU' THEN 21 WHEN 'TU' THEN 22 WHEN 'BSN' THEN 23 WHEN 'BSU' THEN 24 WHEN 'BSX' THEN 25 WHEN 'BSS' THEN 26 WHEN 'BSA' THEN 27 ELSE 99 END

select TOP(10) cn.id AS idx, center_notice_key AS noticeKey, cn.title AS title, cn.sub_title AS subtitle, cn.content AS content, cn.icon AS subicon, cn.created_at AS sdate from erp_student_notice_map snm join erp_center_notice cn on snm.notice_key = cn.center_notice_key where snm.student_id = #{studentId} AND cn.is_delete = 'N' ORDER BY cn.created_at DESC;

SELECT id AS idx, center_notice_key AS noticeKey, title AS title, sub_title AS subtitle, content AS note, icon AS subicon, image AS imgpath, link_url AS linkurl, created_at AS sdate FROM erp_center_notice where id = #{id} AND is_delete = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC;
